skill_changes_summary: Subtraction, 306 -> 258 lines. Replaced the generic Correctness/Security/Error handling/Performance/Best practices/Observability/Maintainability checklists with one short 'Implementation categories' block that names only the checks reviewers skip. Replaced the 18-bullet Guidelines section (16 bullets restated earlier phases) with 5 rules. 'Issues Not Found' is now one line plus exceptions. Added: a runtime finding must construct the concrete failure (input or state -> wrong result) or go to Open Questions; scale the report to the PR; defects the PR did not introduce are not findings against it.

harness.fixture: test-repo/parcelpost/build_fixture.sh builds a checkout on main with a local origin that carries the PR branches and refs/pull/N/head. test-repo/parcelpost/bin/gh is a shim placed first on PATH; it serves pr view / pr diff / repo view from the checkout and logs every call.
harness.independence_probe: The shim serves two incorrect review comments (they assert traps F2 and F3) to any call that asks for reviews or comments, and logs the read. gh_review_reads counts them.
harness.runner: run_skill.sh: one fresh fixture per run, headless claude (claude-opus-5-5), Write/Edit/Agent disallowed for pr-review arms.
harness.scorer: pr_score.py: regex alternatives per planted issue against finding blocks. Trap candidates were adjudicated by hand: all were the true C6 finding, so trap hits are 0 in every arm.

known_limitations: Recall saturates at 1.0 for pr-review in both arms: the planted PR is too easy to detect a small loss of discovery. The next fixture needs subtler defects (cross-file invariants, defects only visible in callers).
Two samples per arm on PR #1, three on PR #2 (one for native). PR #1 differences are inside run-to-run variance.
One Python repo, one PR size (+249/-9). No large or multi-language PR.
Severity expectations in the ground truth are one reviewer's judgment; severity_accuracy counts a match within one level.
The native arm ran at level 'high' with the default findings cap; other levels were not measured. Its prompt is not readable, so the comparison is behavioral.
v2 long-sentence rate rose from 0.8% to 3.7% (STE). Still under the iteration-5 figure of 6.8%, but watch it.
